status: Proposed (2026-10-07) by openspec/changes/light-baking, design sections 11 and 15. Read by docs/mockups/lighting.html and docs/mockups/deck-plan.html through lightbake.js today, by sc-tools bake once it is built. The photometry is the mockup's, judged on its shots, not measured from a real fixture.
_rules: A fixture type is what a fixture record (the kit's lamp rule today; deckgen's placement and the detail files later, deck-pipeline section 7) names. The layout holds no lights.

kind point: a light at a position with a radius (soft shadows), intensity_cd straight down its beam, beam_exponent (cos^n falloff off the axis; 0 lights every way), range_m (where its light ends), drop_m (the light's centre under the lens the kit draws).

kind area: an emissive face (a strip, a screen, a glow band) that lights the room: luminance_cd_m2 over the face's area, range_m; a strip also width_m (across the cove) and end_clear_m (kept off each end of its cove).

light names where its colour per state comes from: lamp, strip or kick (ShipKit.LIGHTING's lamp or strip colour and weight in each state, the state palette every mockup shares), role (the station's role colour, steady in every state) or fixed (color_srgb, steady in every state).

emergency: bus (lit on emergency power only when the record is on the emergency bus) or always. emergency_scale multiplies its emergency-power light (an emergency-bus lamp burns brighter than its share; a screen dims).
Units are in the keys. An unknown key is an error; a missing optional key takes the default stated here (emergency_scale 1). tools/lighting_check.py validates this file.

ceiling_panel._doc: A recessed ceiling panel: beam_exponent 8 puts half its intensity inside 23 degrees of the axis, so it draws a pool. The kit's rule puts one in every frame bay, one per 8 m^2 of floor.

high_bay._doc: The kit's lamp in a room taller than one deck: the same floor light from 6 m up as a panel gives from 3 m.

console_glow._doc: A console's screens lighting the desk and its operator (the deck plan's stations; the lighting page draws its screens as area emitters of console_screen).

cove_strip._doc: A light strip along the middle of every cove the kit builds, and under a mezzanine along its walls.

kick_strip._doc: An indirect strip hidden at the foot of a platform edge (in its toe kick, on a 45 degree chamfer facing out and down) or of a console (openspec/changes/kick-lights): the floor glows, the strip is not seen. Its colour is the state palette's kick colour, the blue of the owner's reference K1 in normal light. Lit on emergency power: it marks the floor edges to the doors.

column_strip._doc: A vertical light column on the wall at each side of a wall bank, behind the terminals (openspec/changes/kick-lights design 2a; the owner, 2026-10-07: "vertical lights behind terminals too", after reference K1's blue light panels beside its consoles). Seen directly; it lights the wall and the bank's fins. Its colour is the state palette's kick colour.

bay_ring._doc: A spacedock bay's general light (openspec/changes/spacedock design 8a): a strip round the bay's wall on every second rib, 80 m apart down E's 620 m bay. Off the emergency bus: red on the station's alert, dark on its emergency supply.

spine_flood._doc: A spacedock bay's high-bay lamp (spacedock design 8a): twelve round the spine every 80 m, each aimed straight out at the bay's round wall, the floor the ships berth on, and throwing a pool about 45 m across on it (the rings staggered by half a step, so the pools lie in a checkerboard with dark between), as a hangar's high-bay lamps pool on its floor. Off the emergency bus; red on alert.

hall_flood._doc: A spacedock hall's high-bay lamp (spacedock design 8a): under the ceiling's gantries in A's round hall and C's drydock, and on the masts down D's cavern, aimed straight down, throwing a pool about 65 m across on the floor from 120-200 m up. Off the emergency bus; red on alert.

ring_flood._doc: A flood on one of B's light rings round its hangar's wall (spacedock design 8a): eight a ring, each aimed across the hangar at its axis, a broad beam that lights the far wall. Off the emergency bus; red on alert.

axis_lamp._doc: A lamp on a hangar's axis (B's spine, spacedock design 8a), lighting every way round it. Off the emergency bus.

bay_flood._doc: A spacedock bay's flood (spacedock design 8a): one a berth, on the spine down the bay's axis, aimed at its berth. Warm and steady for the work on alert; out on emergency power. Radius 0: from 190 m a lens's penumbra is narrower than a 4 m cell.

berth_work._doc: A berth's work light (spacedock design 8a): on the pad's corner masts, the portal frames and under the gantry; bright and short. On the emergency bus at 0.6.

window_tier._doc: A tier of lit control-room windows on a bay's back wall (spacedock design 8a): soft and warm; a little light on the back wall's foot and the sterns. Always lit, at 0.4 on emergency power.
